info.name: Girder REST API (Emory Digital Slide Archive) annotation folder API
folder
Search for folders by certain properties.

params.name: parentType
params.description: Type of the folder's parent

params.name: parentId
params.description: The ID of the folder's parent.

params.name: text
params.description: Pass to perform a text search.

params.name: name
params.description: Pass to lookup a folder by exact name match. Must pass parentType and parentId as well when using this.

params.name: limit
params.description: Result set size limit.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset into result set.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort the result set by.

params.name: sortdir
params.description: Sort order: 1 for ascending, -1 for descending.

items.docs: You must pass either a "folderId" or "text" field to specify how you are searching for folders.  If you omit one of these parameters the request will fail and respond : "Invalid search mode."

info.name: Get a config file.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the document.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the file.

items.docs:
This walks up the chain of parent folders until the file is found.  If not found, the .config folder in the parent collection or user is checked.

Any yaml file can be returned.  If the top-level is a dictionary and contains keys "access" or "groups" where those are dictionaries, the returned value will be modified based on the current user.  The "groups" dictionary contains keys that are group names and values that update the main dictionary.  All groups that the user is a member of are merged

params.description: Whether these settings should only apply to the current user.

items.docs: This replaces or creates an item in the specified folder with the specified name containing a single file also of the specified name.  The file is added to the default assetstore, and any existing file may be permanently deleted.
